worktree_branch.blocked.bisecting: {branch} is mid-bisect in the worktree at {path}. End the bisect there first.
worktree_branch.blocked.delete: {branch} is checked out in the worktree at {path}. Remove that worktree or check out another branch there first.
worktree_branch.blocked.fast_forward: {branch} is checked out in the worktree at {path}, so only that worktree can fast-forward it.
worktree_branch.blocked.missing: {branch} is checked out in the worktree at {path}, whose folder is missing. Prune it first.
worktree_branch.blocked.rebasing: {branch} is mid-rebase in the worktree at {path}. Continue or abort the rebase there first.
worktree_branch.missing.log: {branch} is still checked out in a missing worktree ({path}).
worktree_branch.missing.tip: The worktree at {path} is gone. Prunes it, then checks out {branch}.
worktree_branch.missing.toast: {branch} is still checked out in a worktree whose folder is gone ({path}).
worktree_branch.open.tip.bisecting: Opens the worktree at {path}, where {branch} is mid-bisect
worktree_branch.open.tip.rebasing: Opens the worktree at {path}, where {branch} is mid-rebase
worktree_branch.opened.bisecting: Opened the worktree at {path}, where {branch} is mid-bisect.
worktree_branch.opened.checked_out: Opened the worktree at {path}, where {branch} is checked out.
worktree_branch.opened.rebasing: Opened the worktree at {path}, where {branch} is mid-rebase.
worktree_branch.tip.checked_out: Checked out in the worktree at {path}
